description: Find companies that are hiring for a set of role keywords across public job boards, and return one flat row per posting enriched with company firmographics and the company LinkedIn URL. Discovery runs through the boards named in sources as a chain: seven keyless boards first (Jobicy, Remotive, Arbeitnow, The Muse, Remote OK, We Work Remotely, Himalayas), then Adzuna, then the metered JobsPipe, TheirStack, and Google Jobs on your own keys, only for keywords still short of new companies. Every row carries posted_via, the board the posting was actually published through. Postings are filtered by age, by country, and optionally by employee count, and staffing agencies and freelance marketplaces are dropped by default because they are noise for direct outreach. A cross run delta cache means a repeat run returns only postings it has not emitted before, and previous_run_date lets you set that watermark yourself. max_results caps how many raw postings are pulled before filtering and max_companies caps how many unique companies get enriched, so the two together are the cost dial. Use it to build a list of companies hiring for the roles you sell into. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits; it discovers and enriches and writes nothing.

adzuna_app_id.description: Your Adzuna application id for the adzuna source. It travels in the tool call; the actor's ADZUNA_APP_ID environment variable is used when this is empty.

adzuna_app_key.description: Your Adzuna application key for the adzuna source. The actor's ADZUNA_APP_KEY environment variable is used when this is empty.

company_size_max.description: Optional. Drop companies larger than this (only applied when company size is known).

company_size_min.description: Optional. Drop companies with fewer employees than this (only applied when company size is known).

countries.description: Loop these countries inside one run; overrides country when set. Metered sources query each country separately; keyless remote boards are global and run once. Use the names Google Jobs accepts, for example United States, United Kingdom, Canada.

country.description: Geographic filter, e.g. United States, United Kingdom, Canada. Default: "United States".

enough_new_companies_per_keyword.description: Stop the source chain for a keyword once this many distinct new companies have been found for it this run. Later, metered tiers run only on keywords still below this. Default: 3.

exclude_freelance_marketplaces.description: Filter out postings where the company is a freelance marketplace (Upwork, Fiverr, etc.), which are noise for direct outreach. Default: true.

exclude_staffing_agencies.description: Filter out staffing and recruitment agency postings using name and job-description heuristics. Default: true.

freelance_marketplaces.description: Company names treated as freelance marketplaces and excluded when the toggle above is on. Defaults shown; override or extend as needed. Default: ["Upwork", "Fiverr", "Freelancer", "Toptal", "PeoplePerHour", "Guru", "99designs"].

jobspipe_key.description: Your JobsPipe Bearer key (jp_live_...) for the jobspipe source. JobsPipe bills one credit per job returned. The actor's JOBSPIPE_KEY environment variable is used when this is empty.

keywords.description: Role titles to search for across job boards, one per entry, for example ["account executive", "revops manager"]. Each keyword runs through the source chain separately.

lookback_days.description: Only return postings newer than this many days. Default: 30.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before the next result that would take this run's charges over this amount, and keeps every result already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum cost per run you set in Apify.

max_companies.description: Cap on unique companies enriched per run (firmographics + LinkedIn). Bounds sub-actor cost. Default: 40.

max_results.description: Upper bound on raw postings pulled from the discovery source before filtering. Higher values cost more. Default: 100.

metered_run_cap.description: Ceiling per metered source per country per run: searches for SerpAPI, calls for Adzuna, jobs for JobsPipe and TheirStack. Default: 50.

metered_window_days.description: Only ask the metered sources (jobspipe, theirstack) for postings this many days old or newer. They bill per job returned, seen before or not, so a narrow window is the biggest credit saver. 1 to 7. Default: 2.

previous_run_date.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. 2026-06-01) of your last run. Only postings newer than this are emitted, on top of the built-in cross-run delta cache.

remote_only.description: Only return remote / work-from-home postings. Default: false.

serpapi_key.description: SerpAPI key used for Google Jobs discovery (get a free key at serpapi.com, 250 searches/month, no card). Required to produce results unless a SERPAPI_KEY environment variable is set on the actor.

sources.description: Which job boards to search, run as an ordered chain. Tier 0 needs no key and runs every keyword: jobicy, remotive, arbeitnow, themuse, remoteok, weworkremotely, himalayas. Tier 1 is adzuna (needs adzuna_app_id and adzuna_app_key). Tier 2 runs only on keywords the earlier tiers left short: jobspipe and theirstack (each needs its key, billed by the provider per job returned) and google_jobs (needs serpapi_key). A posting on two boards is deduplicated and counted once. Default: ["google_jobs"].

theirstack_key.description: Your TheirStack API key for the theirstack source. TheirStack bills one credit per job returned. The actor's THEIRSTACK_KEY environment variable is used when this is empty.
